answer: Agents bond stake and commit to an epoch polynomial whose evaluations bind each Semaphore identity to its RLN rate-limit secret. Each message carries a proof and epoch-scoped nullifier; reusing a quota produces two valid shares, which Shamir interpolation combines to recover the signing secret. Anyone can verify the exposure and submit evidence for immediate contract slashing. The anchor is the polynomial commitment; reef and ripple are labels, not additional security guarantees.
